name: constructing-software-stepwise
description: Stepwise refinement for hard designs: one node per approval cycle, one-question-at-a-time interview, contract-preserving decomposition, ADR-gated decisions, evidence-backed verification; Dijkstra-style pseudocode refined until terminal nodes adapt to the real thing (language, framework, platform, service), DESIGN.md holding the assembled program with approved nodes reused as procedures; one file per node (contract, refinement, evidence) and per ADR, context grouped behind a central CONTEXT.md; bundled stdlib CLI (new / sync / check) generates DESIGN.md, CONTEXT tables, links and lints the ledger so the agent writes only reasoning
